name: Lunar Hero Master
scope: The original resolution/sampling/motion target is preserved. The native variant is explicitly bounded to supported samples/depth and does not claim convergence or shutter integration.
limitations: Original sample ceiling exceeds native 4096; the separate bounded projection uses 4096.
Original path depth exceeds native 16; the separate bounded projection uses 16.
Native fixed sampling does not assert the original convergence/error estimator.
Quality specification is a target, not a measured guarantee for every scene.
